summary: Deterministic evaluation under Node 26.5.0: 0/7 hard gates failing and 0/4 quality targets open. The knowledge-lifecycle suite passed 54/54 tests; knowledge-bank and public-safety checks passed with 10 careful-claim guardrail warnings. Weighted judge result: 100.0/100, with all seven criteria at 4/4. The new @KCTownHall census reconciles all 183 items in the surviving July 2026 profile control as 142 account posts, 13 account replies, and 28 reposts, while explicitly refusing native-export, deletion-history, or never-deleted language. The promoted operations claim joins archived collective-role evidence for Julia Fredenburg and Jamie Burkart with Oak Park Neighborhood Association collaboration, resident form and phone or text intake, a recurring schedule, the 100-record tire-workflow pattern, and dated public reporting. Direct responses from three then-serving Council figures and KCMO 311 are kept separate from the nine reposted source statuses belonging to three Council figures. Account-authored reactions are separated from source-status metrics and are not converted into historical analytics, unique people, reach, adoption, endorsement, or impact. Posted journalism remains mission context rather than press coverage of KC Town Hall. Tire and savings figures remain attributed project self-reports pending reconciliation, and private family context remains outside the public repository. The operations-loop and stakeholder-response claims are mature reserve knowledge but remain deferred from website projection. The redacted ledger preserves 183 unique status records, route provenance, classifications, metric ownership, and SHA-256 content digests without raw post text or authenticated-session material. Remaining bounded limits are that the census cannot establish deleted earlier items, individual shared-account authorship, completed pickups, unique resident reports, audited tire or savings totals, complete stakeholder history, historical analytics, adoption, endorsement, or causal neighborhood impact; metric reconciliation, account-establishment evidence, collaborator confirmation, and transition chronology remain bounded research or human-review work; and all three human gates remain pending.
